contract: 5-minute judged demo. Happy path: inbox run -> Brisket Pho below target -> Compare price scenario (+$0.75/order, ~$169/month at 225 forecast orders) -> Approve saves to decision log, never published. Sad paths: rice paper line needs review (crop + packs x sheets correction clears the hold, logged); forwarded scan skipped as duplicate (supplier+number+total). Every number shows its source on tap/hover/Enter. English + Spanish, WCAG 2.2 AA.

accessibility.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility 100 on Morning Brief (Spanish, night), Invoice Review (day) and Dish Detail (day) after fixing two findings (day-mode green pill contrast 4.33 -> 4.5+, Spanish button label-in-name). 137 source popovers on the 3 views: all stay on screen at 390px (fixed position, clamped), Esc closes and keeps focus, hover has a close delay. Touch targets >= 44px (numbers are inline text targets, exempt under 2.5.8). One h1 per view.

responsive.evidence: 390x844 and 1440x900; English and Spanish at 18px and 22px (Larger text): no sideways scroll on any view after fixing grid min-width, unbreakable file names, non-wrapping pills and bottom-nav labels. Invoice line crops are stacked so text is readable on phones.

loading.evidence: role=status spinner on first load and 'Reading the invoice' during upload.

empty.evidence: Brief before any invoice: one sentence plus 'Read tonight's sample invoice' and 'Go to Invoice Review' (v3-01-brief-empty-390.png).

error.evidence: Fix-line dialog with empty pack size and unit shows inline errors (v3-03-fix-line-errors-390.png). Settings 'abc' packaging shows inline Spanish error (v3-07-settings-es-390.png). Unreadable photo returns could_not_read.

partial.evidence: Rice paper line 'Needs review' with highlighted crop holds Spring Rolls while everything else is verified (v4-02-needs-review-crop-390.png); no-AI run falls back to seeded readings and produces the same demo.

success.evidence: Owner confirmed rice paper case = 500 sheets: hold cleared, logged with timestamp and 20 x 25 evidence; approving the scenario saves 'Update this price in your DoorDash Merchant Portal.' (v4-03-fix-rice-paper-390.png, v4-04-while-you-slept-390.png).

permission.evidence: No DoorDash connection: approval never claims publishing; record has published=false; UI says 'Night Shift did not change DoorDash'. Trust rules in Settings: price changes always need the owner's approval.
